test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the correct statement about gravity.

options.text: The unit of g is the same as that of velocity.
The unit of g is the same as that of friction.
The unit of g is the same as that of mass.
The unit of g is the same as that of acceleration.

solution:
The correct answer is 4) __**The unit of g is the same as that of acceleration**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The force of attraction exerted by the earth on a body is called **gravitational pull or gravity.**
 
• We know that when a force acts on a body, it produces acceleration. Therefore, a body under the effect of gravitational pull must accelerate.
 
• The acceleration produced in the motion of a body under the effect of gravity is called **acceleration due to gravity, it is denoted by g and is measured in m/s² .**
 
• The acceleration due to gravity on the surface of the earth is **9.81 m/s² ​.**
 
• ** Statements 1, 2, and 3 are incorrect** because: 
 
 
• 1) **Velocity** is measured in **m/s,** not m/s2; 
 
• 2)** Friction** doesn't have a unit of acceleration, it's a force measured in **Newtons**; 
 
• 3) **Mass** is measured in **kilograms** (kg), not in terms of acceleration.
 
 
 
• Since** g** is measured in** m/s****²** and the same with acceleration, so both have same unit. **Hence option 4 is correct**
